newsitem.title: USA: Transworld to pay $0.30/shr for HMI.
newsitem.headline: Transworld to pay $0.30/shr for HMI.

text.p: Transworld Home HealthCare Inc said Thursday it has amended its previously announced merger agreement with Health Management Inc to pay its stockholders $0.30 per share in cash, a reduction in the previously proposed price of $1.50 per share.

The company also said an agreement has been reached to amend the settlement of the outstanding class action lawsuit against HMI, reducing the settlement to $4.55 million from $7.2 million, subject to certain conditions.

The amendments follow HMI's restatements of its results for its first and second fiscal quarters ended July 31, and Oct 31, respectively. HMI has announced that it has taken a $13 million charge in the third quarter of fiscal 1997.
Completion of the merger is subject to approval by stockholders of HMI, receipt of certain regulatory approvals and approval by Transworld's senior lenders.
The merger, expected to close in June, will be dilutive to Transworld's fiscal 1997 earnings, said the company.
Health Management Inc is a national provider of integrated pharmacy management services. Transworld is a regional provider of alternate site healthcare services and products.
